verdict.rationale: Galileo says it can monitor 100% of live traffic with distilled Luna evaluators. It captures production sessions, traces and spans as a real-time stream, and its log alerts aggregate evaluation metrics such as Correctness and Context Adherence over time windows, which implies evaluators run on live logs rather than only on offline experiments. missing for 10: explicit docs on configuring metrics to run continuously on production log streams (sampling, scheduling, scope), independent or hands-on corroboration that online evaluation works at scale.
